base.description: Same 64x64 pixel-art human fighter, same side pose facing right, same face, navy T-shirt, beige trousers, purple shoes, bare fists, palette and proportions. Remove all hair: completely shaved bald head with a smooth skin-coloured scalp and a clean dark outline around the round skull, ear visible. Nothing else changes. Transparent background.

animations.name: jab
animations.action: Strict SIDE PROFILE facing RIGHT throughout. From this compact fighting stance with bare fists, extend only the lead fist straight to the RIGHT in one quick punch, then retract it to the exact initial stance. Rear fist stays near the cheek, elbows tucked. Never face camera, never spread arms sideways. Feet planted, fixed camera, same bald character and palette.

animations.name: hook
animations.action: Strict SIDE PROFILE facing RIGHT throughout. From this tight stance, rotate the torso slightly and swing the rear fist in a short hook to the RIGHT, then retract to the exact initial stance. Lead fist protects the chin throughout. No frontal pose or arms spread left and right. Fixed camera, planted feet, same bald character and colors.

animations.name: power
animations.action: Strict SIDE PROFILE facing RIGHT throughout. From the stance, bend knees slightly, pull the lead fist beside the chin, then drive a powerful straight two-handed push toward the RIGHT and return to the exact initial stance. Elbows stay close to ribs. Never face camera or spread arms sideways. Same bald character, colors, fixed camera, no projectiles.

animations.name: hurt
animations.action: Strict SIDE PROFILE facing RIGHT throughout. Take one hit from the RIGHT, recoil shoulders and head slightly to the LEFT while keeping both fists close together in front of the chin. Recover into the exact initial stance. Elbows tucked, no arms spread sideways. Same bald character, colors and fixed camera.

animations.name: defeat
animations.action: Strict side view facing RIGHT. Take a final hit from the right, knees buckle, stagger backward to the left and fall onto the floor, ending lying down motionless. Keep the same bald human fighter, clothing and colors, full body visible, transparent background and fixed camera. Do not stand back up.

headItems.description: Same bald 64x64 character, exact same pose, face, body, clothes and palette. Only add short messy medium-brown hair with a few spiky tufts, covering the top and back of the skull, sideburn above the ear on the head. Do not change anything else. Transparent background.

Same bald 64x64 character, exact same pose, face, body, clothes and palette. Only add a medium-brown mohawk: a tall strip of spiky hair along the middle of the skull, sides shaved on the head. Do not change anything else. Transparent background.

Same bald 64x64 character, exact same pose, face, body, clothes and palette. Only add medium-brown hair pulled back into a short high ponytail sticking out behind the head on the head. Do not change anything else. Transparent background.

Same bald 64x64 character, exact same pose, face, body, clothes and palette. Only add a bright red knitted winter beanie hat covering the top of the skull down to the ear, with a folded brim on the head. Do not change anything else. Transparent background.

Same bald 64x64 character, exact same pose, face, body, clothes and palette. Only add a bright blue baseball cap with the visor pointing forward to the right on the head. Do not change anything else. Transparent background.

processing: Frames packed into a 576x384 atlas (rows idle, jab, hook, power, hurt, defeat; column 0 repeats idle) on the y=54 ground line. Head items are the difference between each edit and the bald idle frame, limited to the head and non-skin pixels. anchors.json stores, per atlas cell, the translation and rotation that best fit the idle head skin mask, searched within plus or minus 20 degrees except in the defeat row.

pose.from: stance cell 0 of the outfit atlas
pose.description: Same bald 64x64 pixel-art character, same face, clothes, colours and size. Change only the pose to running: mid-stride side view facing right, front knee lifted, rear leg pushing back, elbows bent about 90 degrees, arms swinging, relaxed open fists. Feet on the same ground line, full body visible.

animation.action: Seamless looping running cycle in place. Strict SIDE VIEW facing RIGHT every frame, never turn toward the camera. Legs alternate: the lifted front knee comes down while the rear leg swings forward, then the other leg lifts; arms pump opposite to the legs with bent elbows. Small up and down bounce of the whole body, head keeps the same size and shape. Same bald character, clothes and colours, full body visible, fixed camera, no ground, no dust.

run.processing: Row 10 of every outfit atlas: column 0 repeats the stance, columns 1 to 8 hold generated frames 0 to 7 (frame 8 equals frame 0 and closes the loop). Alpha is cut at 128, colours snap to the outfit atlas palette, the head from the run pose (with the stance head pixels wherever both overlap) is pasted at the tracked head position so hair and hats sit exactly as in the stance, enclosed gaps of up to 6 pixels are filled, stray shoe or shirt pixels are reassigned to their surrounding material and grey tracksuit stripes are restored to white. Frames are moved down so the lowest foot touches the stance ground line.

pose.description: Same bald 64x64 pixel-art character facing the viewer, same face, clothes, colours, size and feet position. Change only the arms: both upper arms hang close to the body, elbows bent 90 degrees, forearms point forward and slightly outward, both open hands palm up at waist height like weighing something. The right hand is a little higher than the left. Full body visible.

sixseven.processing: Rows 8 and 9 of every outfit atlas: column 1 of row 8 is the relaxed pose, then the 15 generated frames follow, and column 0 of both rows repeats the relaxed pose. Alpha is cut at 128, colours snap to the outfit palette, the exact front head is pasted at the tracked head position so the front hair and hat overlays fit in every frame, and frames keep the front view placement so overlays have room above the head.
